_readme: Hand-maintained owner/local tips. A tip only re-ranks options that are already safe and open (see CampusRouter._applyLocalTip). Never put names, phones or e-mails here. Unverified tips are always labelled in the app. 'when' uses the same windows as parking rules (days 0=Sunday, from/to HH:MM, may cross midnight). The bonus needs the route to use 'entrance' and that door to be public with known open hours.
